On March 25, this year, I participated in 'Varuna Samwad' in Varanasi, organised by Saakhi Research Institute. The discussion was focused on present predicament and possible rejuvenation of small rivers.
comment: Reviving small rivers requires more than restoring flow; long-term success depends on local stewardship, land-use planning, and ensuring communities have incentives to protect these ecosystems.
